notes.title: We are leaving the pit stop! Get ready for the full release!
notes.notes:
Today we're officially bidding farewell to Early Access on Steam and going full throttle with the grand premiere. Death Roads: Tournament has come a long way and has become a better game, thanks to you. Your support through Early Access has been incredible. But remember, the race is far from over!

[previewyoutube=i4ihY4iBvQo;full][/previewyoutube]
What's in store for you?

 New drivers and a fleet of fresh wheels
 Two thrilling status effects
 A lot of new cards  
 A revamped map 
 Stunning biomes 
 Cloud Save support 

But that's not all! We've fine-tuned the gameplay experience:

 Get a sneak peek at your opponent's attack range 
 The ability to skip movements 
 Skid Deck improvements 
 Game events with a more forgiving touch
 Challengers will fight with each other

Full patch notes can be found here. Get ready to hit the road like never before.

notes.title: Death Roads: Tournament - Final Update Changelog
notes.notes:
First of all, thanks for all your feedback folks! With it, we’ve been able to rework a lot of balance and difficulty issues. We’ve also added a bunch of new stuff that hopefully will improve your game experience and let you blow up your foes in new exciting ways.

Let’s run through the details below:

Major Changes


 Flexible movement range - You can now choose a distance you want to travel while performing movement actions stronger than 1. You can also skip any move action entirely while playing a card. This allows for more freedom with positioning. 
 Handling regeneration - Enemies now regenerate handling at the start of the Player’s turn instead of their own. This way you can now limit the amount of cards the enemies will play during their turn, by reducing their handling without making them skid.
 Weapon range highlights - When hovering over an enemy vehicle, you can now see the potential range of all its weapons. The highlighted range of a weapon card is also displayed on the board while hovering over a given weapon card in hand, so you no longer have to activate a card to see where it hits.
 Twists and turns on the world map - The roads on the world map are no longer straight, and now look more like actual routes.
 Unique body cards - The cards from the body components of all playable cars are now unique to each vehicle, and won’t appear in other components like engines, wheels or accessories. We’ve also reworked most of them to better emphasize different playstyles.
 Different driver cards and starting gadgets - All playable drivers now have slightly different cards and starting gadgets, that create better synergies for a given playstyle. 
 Reworked cards and components - Many of the existing cards and components were changed to be clearer and focus more on a given function in specific decks.
 Reworked events - Events now offer better rewards and are less punishing for the Player. 
 Reworked Challenger AI - Challengers in free for all battles can now attack each other instead of focusing only on the Player.


Rebalance 

 Vehicles now have different equipment slot types, as well as new starting values of Condition, Armour and Bash Damage.
 Many components now give different modicator values.
 Some Gadgets values and effects have been changed. 
 Weapons should now deal more damage in general.
 Block and Grip status effects now appear more frequently on different cards.
 Rumble status effect stacks amount has been reduced, and its damage is now subtracted from the Block.
 Action to move in all directions now appears more frequently on cards. 
 Action to redraw cards now appears more frequently on cards.
 Push action now appears more frequently on cards.  
 Players now gain more experience points overall, and can progress quicker. 


Added Content

New Components

 A lot of new Engines, Wheels, Weapons, and Accessories were added. All tuned up, to fit and enhance a specific strategy.

New Gadgets 

 Quite a few new options to gain MORE POWER!!!

New Drivers

 Tetsuo “4rg0” Yamauchi - The Wiz Kid, master of manipulation. 
 Alberto “Flamingo” Felluci - The ex-Mafia chauffeur, here to deliver pain. 

New Playable Car

 Torcia Olympic - Light yourself up in class, with this vintage recreation of the good old days just waiting to be ignited. 

New Enemies

 Three new Sedan type enemies
 Two new Buggy type enemies
 New Hot Rod type enemy
 New Pickup type enemy

New Road types

 Swamp Roads
 Mountain Roads

New Status effects

 Web - Take 2 Condition damage each time this Vehicle moves. Lose 1 Web at the end of your turn.
 Flat - Take 2 Condition damage whenever a Skid card is resolved by this Vehicle. Lose 1 Flat at the end of your turn.

notes.notes:
Rev your engines and get ready for the ultimate showdown!

notes.title: Full release will hit the track in November
notes.notes:
Hey there, drivers!
We've been quiet for a while, but it's not because we've been idling. No, we've been carefully listening to your feedback on Steam and Discord, taking in every bit of your insights to ensure our game aligns with your wildest expectations. After all, you're the ones out there, burning rubber and navigating those insane roads.

Mark your calendars for the full release date: November 15th.

The moment has come to bid adieu to our Early Access phase, and that's no small feat. This shift brought about a slew of changes, including some twists to our roadmap. But fret not, for the majority of those exciting features and promises will indeed find their way into the game. And guess what? We've been doing more than just that. Get ready to see it all unfold very, very soon.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40481305/54c5c3acdead1aec5b139f7aa0ac58918b48d2d5.jpg

Death Roads: Tournament will receive full release on this pivotal day, officially graduating from Early Access. What does this update have in store for you? Well, brace yourselves for new drivers and a fresh set of wheels. We're throwing in not one but two status effects and a truckload of new cards. Thanks to some fantastic biomes, we're even giving the game map a complete makeover.

Did you want challengers to fight each other? Then that's how it will be, too! Were you expecting support for Cloud Save? You will get it! We've even spiced things up with a bunch of new gadgets and accessories. In short, we've been quite busy.

New features, but also changes in gameplay.

But the real magic lies in the subtle touches. We want Death Roads: Tournament to be more approachable without losing its hardcore edge. So, we've implemented many enhancements, like giving you a preview of your opponents' attack range and the ability to skip movements. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40481305/4a2156f9011b160f36b9885e629af17893db98f9.jpg

We've also fine-tuned the Skid Deck and made game events a tad more forgiving. All of this adds up to an entirely different and much more enjoyable gaming experience. But hold your horses, we're not spilling all the beans just yet; you'll have to wait until November 15th to see it for yourself. And for those who've been battling motion sickness, don't worry, we've got your back, too.

We appreciate your unwavering support throughout the Early Access journey. Remember, the race is far from over. So fasten your seatbelts because November 15th, we're hitting the gas pedal and leaving Early Access in the dust!

And all the best for Halloween! Cards-or-Skids for our drivers!

notes.title: Update 1: Roombos, Motorcycles and Motion Sickness
notes.notes:
Hello there, drivers!
The first major content update for Death Roads: Tournament has arrived, and we know you'll like it. However, we warn you that the whole thing has been made available in English so far - other languages ​​will be updated later. We prefer to let you know so that you are not surprised.

Also, if you see any bugs or other issues, let us know whether it's on Steam or Discord. We are at your disposal, and we will be happy to help. Now let's get to the most important thing, which is what Update 1 hides!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40481305/adebf1b650d7bb2a59b87a8af8b72f2ced9c1bf9.png
Gameplay Changes:

 Added a new tab in the settings menu, "Motion Sickness Settings", to address motion sickness issues experienced by some players. Players can now adjust parameters such as motion blur, camera shake, and the number of props appearing on the sidelines of roads to mitigate motion sickness. This is the first version of the solution, which will be further improved.

New Enemies:

 Introducing motorcycles and Roombo cleaning robots as new enemy vehicles players can encounter.
 Motorcycles are agile but deal low damage with their bashes and have limited durability. Each bike has a single-ranged attack with a limited range. Chopper fires short bursts to the sides while Cross throws grenades backwards through its left or right arm.
 Roombo cleaning robots have limited but versatile movement capabilities. Their signature attack pushes the player sideways, potentially pushing them into a wall. Beware of the more powerful Turbo Roombo version, which can heal itself by attacking the player.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40481305/1b8588c1a906d6d32fb451b652187f47329bfd72.png
New Accessories:

 Added a new type of component that can be obtained and equipped in most playable vehicles. Some accessories provide positive modifiers, while others add unique cards to enrich the deck with specific functions, such as powerful status effects or strong movement actions. There are 24 of them in total. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40481305/7975da0103daf4e059dc4cf16d365fd37130f5f9.png
New Gadgets:

 Expanded the pool of obtainable gadgets by introducing 25 new unique modifiers that enhance gameplay and encourage players to utilize existing game mechanics in new ways.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40481305/4af3fc186e776f6a4bad4e0f1866ac59cf7e8965.png
New Events:

 Included 12 new events that offer the opportunity to acquire gadgets, while others lead to unique encounters and battles.

New Wheels and Engines:

 Increased the variety of available cards and rewards obtained in battles and shops by introducing 8 new wheels and engines. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40481305/98794651bbf65f7fe82efaf115792b6f96d0d5c3.png
Bug Fixes and General Improvements:

 Addressed various bug issues and improved overall game stability and performance.


We hope you enjoy the latest update and have an exhilarating experience in Death Roads: Tournament!

notes.title: Patch Notes 0.9.3.89
notes.notes:
Hello Drivers!

First patch is now live! Changes down below.

Gameplay:
- Healing in Fix Station has a constant cost throught the run equal to the previous lowest value (1 Scrap = 1 Condition).

Changes:
- Visual and functional changes in the Garage. Auto-save was added. Spare Components integrated into Slots (not visible in inventory).
- Visual and functional changes in Settings. Completely new tabbed window design.
- Visual and functional changes in Vehicle Details.
- Visualization of the cost of the selected card in the Handling Bar.
- Ability to cancel the selected card with RMB.

Bug fixes:
- Incorrect display of Score during death in Events.
- Incorrect display of New symbol on Component in Battle Rewards.
- Double-clicking on an empty slot in the Garage caused an error.
- Bug fixes in the Saves system.
- Localization bug fixes.

notes.title: Happy Easter! Curious about the update and roadmap?
notes.notes:
Death Roads: Tournament kicked off last week, and, of course, it was not without fail start. Fortunately, our brave mechanics repaired the car, which finally stood on the starting line. Well, off we went, and you along with us, for which we thank you sincerely.

This week was a real no-holds-barred ride. You have shown great interest in the game, shared with us accurate comments and provided us with plenty of suggestions. We take them all to heart and will even implement some of them.

[previewyoutube=tlzYxOT85oo;full][/previewyoutube]
First patch and the roadmap

Next week, the first patch *should be released, correcting several problems and fixing some bugs. For example, we will lower the cost of healing - the full patch notes with all the changes will appear in a separate post. However, you need to know that this is just the beginning, and we intend to improve Death Roads: Tournament regularly: with your help!

Driver does not live by patches alone, so we will provide you with a roadmap later this month. Thanks to it you will learn what we have hidden in the garage - you will not be able to complain about the lack of attractions. That's why we ask for a little more patience because it will be rewarded!

And finally, we wish you a happy Easter holiday. Rest and gain strength because the race continues!

*We reserve the right to delay - anything can happen on the road!

notes.notes:
As announced before, it's time to turn off our demo. We are INCREDIBLY surprised by your interest in our game, and thank you for that. Some of you were surprised by the volume of the demo, and we assure you that Death Roads: Tournament will offer much more than what you've seen. You will find out about it …

We will remind you about everything, so take it easy - you won't miss it. In the meantime, keep an eye out for more news and see ya later!

notes.title: Dev Update #2 Tutorial or prologue? Why not both!
notes.notes:
Have you shifted gears in any other card game? Probably not. Just like many of our players during the Closed Beta testing. We collected your feedback and decided to make some changes; thanks to you! We hope they will help introduce new players to the basic assumptions of the game and, at the same time, serve as a quick intro to the world of Death Roads.

Not a boring tutorial. It's an active prologue!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40481305/80627d76fd352d2c3afb264a8f735fecc1d2c24e.png
In addition to a few mechanics known from the roguelike genre, the game introduces some unique systems we haven’t met so far in other deck-builders. The most important are Gear shifts, the associated Skid, and the Bash. These mechanics will be the “main target” of our new tutorial on which we are working.

It will act as a prologue and take us to the times of tutorial Grandma’s youth - the final of the first edition of Death Roads: Tournament! Her older self, Margaret “Teacher” Murdock, will tell you about crazy adventures in this historic fight, sharing some tricks and commenting on the player's actions in dialogue bubbles.

Run the prologue once and get tired no more!
The prologue will guide the player through fundamental concepts such as using attack, move, Bash, Gear cards, allowing opponents to Skid etc. All within one turn, after which you can either finish the fight how you want or skip the rest of the prologue - it’s your choice. This is a separate game mode, available in the main menu, so you won't need to repeat it with each normal run! Or maybe you should? Who knows!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40481305/f2d5fa993fe9e8850965fd7fe85969393feb4a35.jpg
Several less essential mechanics, such as status effects or surface changes, will be contextually explained during the game when they occur for the first time. This will avoid a situation where we shower the player with too much information. The player will also have access to help screens, allowing him to recall the basic rules at any time during the game. We won’t leave you alone, no worries!

Little sneak peek

Finally, we wanted to present some text suggestions for the intro we plan to put at the beginning of the prologue. Please let us know what you associate it with and if it's not too cheesy :P. We'd love to hear from you!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40481305/6c592c0a27cde3d6bfe504ca180664bfcd73964f.png

“Road… Road never changes… I mean, there are new potholes, new assholes, and the way may differ… but the Road… never changes. Each year, when the Hurricanes converge, it always leads to the same place. The finals at the gates of the great ECCT. Although not many are still alive to reach it in the end ...
Have I told you about the time when I was in my prime, battling the final stage of the first Death Roads Tournament?"

Stay tuned and keep your engines hot!

notes.title: Dev Update #1 Where will the road take us?
notes.notes:
Welcome to Death Roads, drivers, the most dangerous race on this side of the Divided States of America. The Tournament may be going on, but we'd like to take a few moments before you participate. It would be good to know where we are currently on the route, right?

As already announced, Death Roads: Tournament is approaching its release on Steam in Early Access. We are not revealing a specific date yet, but be sure that it is closer than further. As we promised, we will shower you with an absolute avalanche of information about the project, so be prepared!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40481305/d4dad7dbee6713f2cb5ef624e5e035ee31af6a7a.png

What is the current development status?

At this point, we can undoubtedly say that the core of the game has been tuned. Death Roads consists of three elements: progression on the world map, turn-based combat and deckbuilding. You choose your own path, compete with the opponents, and then choose rewards that will allow you to modify your vehicle in the garage. Along the way, you can get to the city, where you can come across, for example, another race participant who plays the role of a mini-boss, shops and fix stations where you can fix or upgrade your vehicle. That's it, in a nutshell. But is it true? You will find out about it by reading on!

What are the main features we are working on?

We are currently expanding the race to provide more attractions and less repetition. You can also count on additional vehicles and drivers, new types of enemies, dialogue events and the Final Boss. The latter is the apple of our eye, and we want it to be really exciting.

We are also adding more music and enriching the world map while polishing some parts of the game and fixing bugs. So as you can see, work on Death Roads: Tournament is going on full throttle! Early Access is just the beginning of the race, and we plan to diversify it even more in the future.

What is the road plan? 

We plan to add new functionalities to differentiate the gameplay and give players new modifiers to get in the form of gadgets and sponsors to choose from at the beginning of the game. There will also be an unlock and achievement system. You can also count on "Driverpedia", where you can see your progress and get more information about your opponents.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40481305/d629cdf67834a9aae47345148af25d97a1d62b49.gif

Although Death Roads: Tournament is a turn-based production with cards, we want to reflect the realities of an actual, dangerous race. That's why we plan to add the weather mechanics over time and tell you the story of the tournament in an exciting way - because the last element is really important!

If you are hungry for details, check out our Discord. You will find first-hand information there, and we will also answer your questions. 

And see you in Death Roads!

notes.title: Let's begin this race - Deah Roads coming to EA release!
notes.notes:
Welcome to all fans of fast cars, dangerous racing and turn-based games. This is our first entry, and as you know, the first step is the hardest! Now that we have it behind us, it's time for the specifics.

Death Roads: Tournament is a game that combines turn-based gameplay with tactical elements, diversifying the whole thing with things known from the roguelike and deck-builders genres. Pretty crazy mix, right?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40481305/ee5358e222752c6aca727ba71ac717e0dd2bc1d0.gif

The result is a turn-based game about a blood-curdling TV tournament in which YOU will take part! You will have to rush ahead, eliminating enemies and watching out for various attractions along the way. All this to win the grand prize.

Death Roads: Tournament is nearing its Early Access debut. For this reason, expect regular information about the game: its mechanics and the story. So fasten your seat belts, for it will happen! 

For first-hand news, join our Discord: https://discord.gg/pQ6vqqGb2V  

Take care, Drivers! 
DRT Team
